title: Sa Bang-ji
overview: استمتع بمشاهدة فيلم Sa Bang- مترجم بجودة عالية.

ai_content.intro: يحكي فيلم "صا بانغ-جي" قصة حياة شخص ما يُعرف باسم صا بانغ-جي خلال فترة Joseon في تاريخ كوريا.
ai_content.desc_ar: استمتع بمشاهدة فيلم Sa Bang- مترجم بجودة عالية.
ai_content.desc_en: Sa Bang-ji is a historical drama that tells the story of an intersex person who lived during Korea's Joseon Dynasty. The film follows the life of Sa Bang-ji, who was taken in by a kindly benefactor and lives in a monastery. The story revolves around the meeting between Sa Bang-ji and a young widow, Lee So-sa, who is in mourning following the death of her husband. Their encounter seems predestined, with the erotic attraction between them evolving into something far more transcendent and dangerous. The film highlights the stigmatization faced by Sa Bang-ji and his community, refusing to shy away from the harsh realities of their experiences.
